verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the Zebra artwork within a refined, organic, textural resort-wear visual brief.
The client accepts the immediately preceding Zebra proposal defining its gold/camel palette, gestural stripes, and lively rendered character.
The client explicitly requires a black border around the Zebra artwork.
First target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports three developed Zebra directions shown as tile details and full repeats.
The client changes the Zebra artwork palette toward a lighter, less-gold appearance.
The client specifies concrete Zebra palette, contrast, grain, texture, edge, rendering, and stripe-scale changes.
The client selects the Zebra Savanna artwork option and requires its yellow/gold tone to be reduced.
The client reopens option and scale selection and requests a reduced tone; border_required is unchanged from the existing Zebra border requirement.
Target-specific post-revision claim: the freelancer reports three Zebra directions revised to a softer caramel/bronze palette with lower contrast.
First concrete client approval after reviewing the revised Zebra artwork, authorizing progression to final artwork.
The artwork change is the newly specified small border size; the black Zebra border requirement already exists.
The final Zebra option and exact border measurement remain materially unresolved before final artwork preparation.
The client selects the smaller Zebra Noir Edited artwork and replaces the border treatment with an edge-to-edge, borderless repeat.
The client resolves the outstanding option and border questions, returning the Zebra requirement to active execution.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_002]

1\. Zebra Print - Our actual preference is the smaller-scale ZEBRA NOIR option: Gastaldon\_Textil ZebraNoir\_ Edited
2\. Borders - We’ve chosen NO BORDERS! Please remove every border so the print repeats easily, with the artwork extending fully to the edge. What you have already supplied is perfect.
3\. Yes, retain those measurements: 7cm thinner and 17cm + Seam allowance 1.5 cm, which will accommodate a rolled hem finish.
4\. Pantone colours - that works for us. Thank you so much!
Thank you! xx

execution.observed_behavior: The client selects the smaller-scale Zebra Noir Edited artwork and states that the already-supplied borderless, edge-to-edge artwork is perfect.
